rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a situation or outcome that looks likely to succeed.

example.jyutping: go3 gai3 waak6 tai2 lok6 gei2 jau5 hei1 mong6

rows.note: Use this when describing a person who feels full of hope, often with 對未來 or another target.

example.english: I feel hopeful about the future.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 mei6 loi4 cung1 mun5 hei1 mong6

rows.note: Use this for someone whose general outlook is optimistic rather than specifically focused on one hoped-for result.

example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 lok6 gun1
